newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin names loyal general number two in army.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin names loyal general number two in army.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin appointed a loyal ally, Lieutenant General Viktor Chechevatov, as the head of the general staff of the armed forces on Thursday, Interfax news agency said, quoting military sources.
There was no official confirmation of the report.

Earlier on Thursday, Yeltsin sacked Defence Minister Igor Rodionov and the head of the general staff, General Viktor Samsonov, accusing them of doing nothing to reform the underfunded and inflated army.
The head of the general staff is number two in Russia's armed forces. He is the third person, after the president and the defence minister, to have control over the use of nuclear weapons.
Chechevatov, 52, commanded the Far East military district and is seen by the Russian media as one of the strongest Yeltsin supporters in the top brass.
